The 2002 San Marino Grand Prix (round 4, held at Imola on 14 April 2002) was won by Michael Schumacher driving for Ferrari. He started from pole, and Rubens Barrichello finished second for Ferrari, with Ralf Schumacher third for Williams.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher
